paragraphs.text: Badger is a green or red creature type for cards that depict lifelike short-legged, heavy-set digging omnivores.
The first card to bear the type was the Giant Badger which came as a media insert with the Greensleeves book Shattered Chains .

The type was reused for Homelands which had Rysorian Badger , and for Mercadian Masques which had the red Rock Badger . Much later, the creature type reappeared in Born of the Gods ( Charging Badger ), Commander 2020 ( Surly Badgersaur ), Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate ( Colossal Badger ), and Dominaria United ( Bog Badger ). Bloomburrow featured the first legendary badger.
Badgerfolk are one of the animalfolk of Bloomburrow .
One of their kin, Hugs , assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts .
Badgers on Dominaria are known to inhabit bogs. It is also home to Giant Badgers, which have white fur, six eyes, and large horns.
The archdruid Greensleeves is known to have summoned badgers to fight by her side.
Mercadia is home to beasts known as Rock Badgers that are orange-furred badgers with white & black stripes, large claws, and a mouth with a tooth-like beak and two large lower teeth. .

The badgers of Theros are known to be very aggressive and will charge quickly. Anthousa stated that if the hierarchies of nature were determined by ferocity alone, then they would call the badger the lord of the beasts.
People on Thunder Junction use Burrowfiends as a mount , which are a type of badger beast. They are long-legged badgers with black fur and a large maw with sharp teeth.
Ulgrotha is home to the Rysorian Badgers, which are small animals that inhabit the forest.
Avatar: The Last Airbender featured Badgermoles ( 9 cards ), which are large blind subterranean creatures that are a cross between a badger and a mole .
